title: Home-page Reference cards show the readers' rating beside Cyclotron confidence, labelled apart (PPY-1b83d3 cards)
description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Files: `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/home_page_components.py` (`tile`, `row`, `confidence_markup`, `row_confidence_markup`; new `reader_rating_markup`), `src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/home_page_blocks.py` (the `references` include: read `_data/reader/items.json` or the home-page snapshot's copy of the reader block), `src/papyrus_content/home_page/export.py` (join each exported Reference with its `reference:<id>` block from the reader snapshot into `readerRating: {mean, n}`; allowlisted fields only), the home-page stylesheet `papyrus-home-page.css`, `features/newsroom-reference-feed.feature` or the home-page feature file that covers the cards (find with `grep -rln "confidence" features features_backend`), `src/papyrus_content/home_page/export_test.py`.

## Change
On Reference tiles and rows, next to Cyclotron's "93% confidence" (gauge icon), show the readers' rating: Lucide `star` icon + "4.2 from 31 readers" (tile) / "4.2★ · 31" with a visually hidden "readers' rating" (row). Two distinct labels, two distinct icons, so confidence and rating are never confused; both are icon + text, never colour alone, no borders. When n is 0 the rating line is omitted (not "0 from 0"). Server-rendered, no script; the live star control is the island story. The export joins reader data only when the site has `reference` voting on (`projection.json` `homePage.references.readerRating: true`, default off); otherwise the markup is byte-identical to today.

## Gherkin
  Scenario: A Reference card shows the readers' rating beside Cyclotron's confidence, labelled apart
  Scenario: A Reference with no reader judgements shows only the confidence
  Scenario: A site without Reference voting renders the cards exactly as before
  Scenario: The home-page data files carry means and counts and no reader
  Scenario: The rating is readable without colour

## Acceptance
`poetry run pytest src/papyrus_content/home_page src/papyrus_content/projection`; the front-end cucumber suite; a local projection of anth.us's `newsroom` page from a fixture shows both numbers. Blocked by the snapshot story (shape) and the Reference-subject story (data). Part of the PPY-1b83d3 card work; link it there as relates-to.
